usageNote: 正式场合专用！写简历、介绍人物时超好用，语气自带光环✨，口语里一说就显得很厉害！

examples.en: She has won many national and international prizes for her research in medicine.
examples.zh: 她因医学研究赢得了许多国内外奖项。

examples.en: This young musician has won many national and international prizes before the age of 20.
examples.zh: 这位年轻音乐家在20岁前就赢得了许多国内外奖项。
